if_narrative_were_mistaken_for_verified_.note: Illustration of the conjunction rule on the narrative labels. Not an incident verdict and not adopted.

telemetry_required.observation: Dataset-worker allowlist decisions with timestamp, worker id, URL class (platform or non-platform), decision enum, and whether a fetch client was invoked.
telemetry_required.why_insufficient: The timeline paraphrases a ValueError. That sentence is not the allowlist log, and a reported rejection is not an observation that other boundaries held. The record is unavailable. That is not a property-contract failure, and the proposition is well-formed without it.
telemetry_required.qualifying_source: Hugging Face dataset-worker or datasets-library audit for the cited requests.

telemetry_required.observation: File-open audit with path class (dataset sandbox or worker-local), dataset revision, and whether bytes were returned. Not the bytes.
telemetry_required.why_insufficient: The timeline asserts a worker-local read and says no code ran. This repository does not contain the open audit, so the disclosure is not independently refuted or supported. The record is unavailable. That is not a property-contract failure, and the proposition is well-formed without it.
telemetry_required.qualifying_source: Worker filesystem audit bound to the dataset revision, separate from the blog text.

telemetry_required.observation: Boolean that untrusted configuration was evaluated as code, with workload id and timestamp. Not the template and not a payload.
telemetry_required.why_insufficient: The timeline separates code execution from the file-read vector. The separation is a narrative claim until a process audit records the boolean independently of the file-open audit. The record is unavailable. That is not a property-contract failure, and the proposition is well-formed without it.
telemetry_required.qualifying_source: Worker process or config-evaluation audit that does not reuse the file-open record as its only source.

telemetry_required.why_insufficient: The timeline says one shared connector identity was cluster-admin. The authz log is not in this repository, and the sentence is not a URL-allowlist observation. The record is unavailable. That is not a property-contract failure, and the proposition is well-formed without it.
